headline: Conditional Access Policy and AD-SPM now require Cortex agent 9.3 or later
summary_md:
- **Conditional Access Policy** and **AD-SPM** both gained a minimum agent version — 9.3 or later — with CAP taking effect only after an agent restart.
- The requirement was added to both copies of the Identity Profile note, under ITDR and under endpoint security.
- The endpoint-security copy's tenant prerequisites were rewritten from Cortex XSIAM to Cortex XDR versions, so the two copies of that note no longer agree.
- The **AD-SPM** toggle description lost its sentence about using Weak Password to identify weak passwords and set a scan frequency.
- A four-page day, all of it Identity Profile: no pages added, renamed or removed.

highlights.title: Conditional Access Policy requires Cortex agent 9.3 or later and takes effect after an agent restart
highlights.detail: The restart condition is new text rather than a restatement, and it was added to the CAP prerequisites and to both Identity Profile notes in one edit.

highlights.title: Active Directory Security Posture Management requires Cortex agent 9.3 or later
highlights.detail: Stated in both Identity Profile notes; the AD-SPM page itself was untouched apart from a list reformat.

highlights.title: The endpoint-security Identity Profile note now names Cortex XDR versions where it named Cortex XSIAM
highlights.detail: "Cortex XSIAM 3.5" became "Cortex XDR 3.5" and "unavailable for Cortex XSIAM 2.x" became "Cortex XDR 2.x", while the ITDR copy still says XSIAM — the two notes now state different tenant prerequisites.

highlights.title: The AD-SPM toggle no longer documents Weak Password scan frequency
highlights.detail: Both copies dropped the sentence directing you to use Weak Password to identify weak passwords in Active Directory and define the scan frequency.

items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: CAP prerequisites now state agent version 9.3 or later, and that the policy takes effect only after an agent restart.
Adds minimum agent 9.3 lines for both CAP and AD-SPM, and trims the AD-SPM toggle description to drop Weak Password scan frequency.
items.xsiam/protect-your-endpoints/endpoint-se: Gains the same 9.3 requirements and the Windows-endpoints line, but rewrites the tenant prerequisites from Cortex XSIAM to Cortex XDR versions.
items.xsiam/detect-investigate-and-respond-to-: Converts the two ways to investigate posture issues from a numbered list to bullets — they are alternatives, not ordered steps.
